title: How a clash of the registry's live layer at one address was settled (<home>/state/registry-live/settled/<binary>/<build>/<rva>.json)
description: Two ids claimed for one function are a clash until it is settled: one id kept, or the ids declared folded (the linker gave identical code one address). Written by `gatekit registry settle`.

keep.description: The id that stays; the other claims at the address are dropped from commits.

folded.description: Every id at the address stands: the code is one function of several names.
